scope: Logical PostgreSQL M1 design; not executable DDL or an applied migration. Later milestones add trials, KMS rotation, retention and new checkpoint formats.

types.object: JSONB for versioned bounded metadata only

constraints: Exactly one organization enabled per deployment; no shared SaaS claim.

fields.name: varchar(120) NOT NULL
fields.run_sequence: bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0; AR-006-A adds per-project publication counter

constraints: UNIQUE(organization_id,id)
PK(project_id,principal_id)
Organization administrator authority comes from validated identity mapping, not request body.
Revocation is checked on each operation, including idempotent replay.
Unique active legacy_default per principal in the single enabled organization; no implicit sole-membership fallback.
principal_id is oidc:<SHA256 canonical exact verified issuer+subject> or api-key:<id>; old issuer-less sessions must reauthenticate.
PK(resource_kind,resource_id)
UNIQUE(project_id,resource_kind,resource_id)
Cover legacy run,study,job,key ownership without rewriting encrypted payloads.
Every resource lookup requires scope before loading its body.
Resource kind/id existence and same-project run/study/job ancestry are validated in the publishing transaction; ambiguous legacy rows cannot activate.
Service-key scope is immutable; live key role intersects live project membership. Organization administration does not imply project data access.

fields.published_seq: bigint NOT NULL; immutable per-project commit-ordered publication sequence
fields.projection_reason: varchar(32) NULL; fixed audited reconciliation code, never exception text

constraints: UNIQUE(project_id,run_id)
Composite FK(project_id,parent_id) -> run_index(project_id,run_id)
INDEX(project_id,created_at DESC,run_id DESC)
Mutable query projection; immutable event bodies/digests remain unchanged.
Publish projection progress with event/ref metadata under the same job generation fence. Preserve records.data and historical event/artifact bytes.
Expired/lost/terminal job plus stale running manifest projects incomplete and non-branchable; complete task failure remains complete.
created_at is UTC nearest-microsecond ties-to-even projection; preserve original float in records.created. Cursor upper published_seq excludes later backfills.

UNIQUE(project_id,published_seq); allocate by locking and incrementing projects.run_sequence in the insert transaction, holding that project lock through commit. No preallocated sequence or I/O under this lock; database sequence allocation alone is not commit ordering.

fields.job_id: id FK jobs UNIQUE NOT NULL
fields.failure_correlation_id: id NULL; persisted trusted origin correlation, not each poll ID

constraints: UNIQUE(project_id,principal_id,kind,client_operation_id)
UNIQUE(project_id,principal_id,kind,id)
Publish operations+jobs+scope+audit atomically after confirmed artifact upload.
Same canonical request returns original IDs; changed request conflicts; recheck current access.
Retain through operation lifetime plus at least 90 days.
Composite FK(project_id,job_resource_kind,job_id) -> resource_scopes(project_id,resource_kind,resource_id); job_id also references actual jobs.

request_digest covers version-normalized client intent only; execution_config_digest freezes separately resolved config for first admission. Retry resolves existing identity before mutable config/storage writes.
UNIQUE(project_id,digest,format_version)
UNIQUE(project_id,id)
byte_count >= 0; IDs are authorization-scoped locators, never public access tokens.
M1 retains existing encrypted format as version 1; no online re-encryption yet.
New verified put-if-absent is scoped to project and format; retained format-1 locators stay readable without rewriting ciphertext.
Record backend request count separately from logical put count; existing S3 hash addressing does not deduplicate requests (CAP-01).
PK(project_id,owner_kind,owner_id,artifact_id,role)
Composite FK(project_id,artifact_id) -> artifact_objects(project_id,id)
Composite FK(project_id,owner_kind,owner_id) -> resource_scopes(project_id,resource_kind,resource_id)
Publish reference only after confirmed object write/hash verification; no deletion API in M1.
Register every reachable schema-1 child hash under its scoped root owner before publication; authorize owner+role+digest before cache/storage access.
Provider-call budget_evidence references require owner_kind=provider_call, owner_id=call_id and matching project.
System sentinel is outside customer object/ref tables in a fixed installation namespace; never a generic unscoped read escape hatch.

fields.opening_held_microusd: money NOT NULL DEFAULT 0; immutable imported exposure

constraints: UNIQUE(organization_id,scope,scope_id,period_start)
All money nonnegative; held+accounted <= limit.
Period bounds UTC, nonoverlapping for a scope. Job accounts use fixed job-lifetime bounds; calls retain admission-period account IDs.
Composite FK(organization_id,project_id) -> projects(organization_id,id) where project_id non-null.

CHECK explicit scope shape: organization requires scope_id=organization_id AND project_id IS NULL AND job_id IS NULL; project requires project_id IS NOT NULL AND scope_id=project_id AND job_id IS NULL; job requires project_id IS NOT NULL AND job_id IS NOT NULL AND scope_id=job_id. No nullable equality may satisfy a branch through SQL UNKNOWN.
Deferred ownership trigger verifies job scope project, exact account scope and nonoverlapping half-open periods; job account uses immutable job lifetime.
held includes opening_held once plus unresolved new call reserves. Outstanding prior-period holds constrain new-period admission until evidenced reconciliation/transfer; no cap reset shortcut.
UNIQUE(project_id,logical_call_id)
Amounts nonnegative; usage estimate separate from charge reconciliation.
M1 adds ledger primitives; discovery receipts and resume/reconciliation UI are completed in M3.
Unknown dispatch/response leaves reservation held; retry returns same logical call reservation.
UNIQUE(project_id,id); composite FK(project_id,job_resource_kind,job_id) -> resource_scopes(project_id,resource_kind,resource_id).
Deferred trigger validates exactly one organization/project/job account of the matching org/project/job and frozen admission period. IDs never change on reconciliation.
Publish same-project resource_scopes(provider_call,id) with call row. Logical-call reuse with changed request digest/amount/price/purpose conflicts, never grants new dispatch.

Compare current job owner+lease_generation+status+database-time lease+cancel before reserve/dispatch transition/publication. reserved->dispatching is one fenced compare-and-set; ambiguous outcome retains hold.
Composite FK(organization_id,project_id) -> projects(organization_id,id).
PK(call_id,account_id,entry_kind)
Lock all scope accounts in deterministic ID order; reserve all or none in one transaction.
Settlement/release requires reconciliation evidence; never release solely for a timeout.
Existing jobs.reserved remains consistent during compatibility window; no double counting.
Composite FK(project_id,call_id) -> provider_calls(project_id,id). Deferred trigger permits account_id only among that call's three frozen account IDs.

Nullable composite FK(project_id,evidence_owner_kind,call_id,evidence_ref,evidence_role) -> artifact_refs(project_id,owner_kind,owner_id,artifact_id,role). Evidence required for settle/release; trusted reconciliation validates evidence authority/amount.
For bound R and evidenced charge C<=R, settle moves C held->accounted and evidenced release removes R-C; all levels update atomically, no timeout release.

Opening historical holds are separate account opening balances, not invented provider calls. jobs.reserved remains opening L_j + sum(new R), including later released reservations; enforce gross job ceiling conservatively.
PK(project_id,principal_id,kind,key_hash)
Composite FK(project_id,principal_id,kind,operation_id) -> operations(project_id,principal_id,kind,id)
A retry with an existing client_operation_id and a new key records an alias atomically after comparing the canonical digest.
A key already bound to a different operation/request conflicts; all aliases live as long as their operation.

migration_protocol: Drain API/worker/CLI writers and require terminal legacy jobs. Verify backup/evidence plus DB writer exclusion; schema-qualified dialect catalog fingerprint under bounded lock through stamp. Reject unknown columns/types/defaults/constraints/indexes/write-changing triggers/rules and unknown/newer/multiple revision heads before DDL.
Install additive revisions; require explicit legacy project mapping before backfill; preserve original IDs, timestamps, hashes, encrypted objects and historical budget values.
Backfill scoped indexes in resumable bounded batches; report unmappable records, including parent lineage, instead of dropping them.
Verify counts, scope closure, event-chain heads and artifact digests. Switch all legacy/current reads through scoped repositories before admitting a second project.
API/worker runtime credentials have no DDL privilege. Runtime startup checks revision compatibility; migrations are an explicit operator command.
Document downgrade as unsupported where unsafe; application rollback only to compatible readers or a verified restore. Never rehash history during backfill.

AR-005-B owns explicit baseline/adoption metadata; AR-007-A owns all ownership tables/backfill; AR-006-A projection, AR-009-A artifacts, AR-008-A admission, AR-010-A ledger. One linear revision chain; incomplete prepared adoption is not customer readiness.

transactions.submit: Authorize and normalize stable client intent -> resolve both identities and existing accepted response before mutable config/upload -> for new operation freeze admin config, upload/verify task+config+envelope -> transaction recheck authorization/uniqueness, publish refs+job+scope+operation+key aliases+audit atomically -> 202. Racing winner returns original identity; orphan uploads remain unpublished. Unknown commit acknowledgment uses outcome_uncertain.
transactions.reserve: Check job owner/generation/cancel/DB-time lease -> lock frozen org/project/job accounts in sorted ID order -> idempotent logical call with exact request/price/amount/purpose -> enforce opening obligations, gross job cap and current shared caps -> insert call/scope/entries and balances atomically -> permit. Fenced reserved->dispatching transition is single-use; no network inside transaction or retry after ambiguous dispatch.
transactions.cancel: Authorize project/action -> atomically record intent and audit; queued job becomes cancelled, terminal status remains unchanged.

fields.payload_version: integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1; legacy body readers remain 1; new v1 native-run envelopes use 2 (AR-008-A)
fields.lease_generation: bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0; increment successful claim (AR-010-A)
fields.legacy_reserved_microusd: money NOT NULL; immutable copied jobs.reserved at adoption, zero for new jobs (AR-010-A)
fields.execution_config_ref: digest NULL for retained historical jobs; required scoped admission_config artifact reference for every new job (AR-008-A)
fields.execution_config_digest: digest NULL for retained historical jobs; immutable required frozen config identity for every new job (AR-008-A)

jobs.preservation: Never alter original columns/rows to satisfy projection or fabricate historical dispatch; no mixed legacy writers.
constraints: All new run/branch/study/investigate jobs atomically bind execution_config_ref/digest to the same project/job admission_config artifact ref; legacy bodies remain unchanged.
Retained null config jobs are read-only/non-redispatchable without explicit compatible mapping; do not infer current settings from payload_version=1.
Worker verifies common job config before paid dispatch; v2 envelope config must exactly agree with job config. Legacy source checkpoint policy/image must be explicitly compatible.
No premature ownership FKs; AR-007-A creates real ownership rows and verifies exact mapping.
Prepared is schema adoption only; integrity/ownership/backfill readiness must pass before activation.
Identical mapping/evidence re-entry is idempotent; changed mapping or source digest conflicts, requiring explicit reviewed recovery.

Fresh install records source_kind=fresh, verified empty-source fingerprint, null target/evidence and fresh-only mapping; AR-007-A explicit operator initialization supplies ownership/grants atomically. Never run legacy adopt on a versioned fresh install.

Legacy source requires non-null target/evidence and bounded schema-1 mapping naming dataset digest, all-verified-legacy-resources selector, canonical grants/defaults and key dispositions. Unknown kinds/ambiguous closure block activation.
Target organization/project IDs may be NULL only for fresh/prepared state; ownership_complete always requires both targets.

Backup/drain evidence is required for legacy source in every state, and explicitly NULL/inapplicable for fresh source in both prepared and ownership_complete; never fabricate legacy evidence for initialization.
Cursor and completed batch commit atomically; changed source identity blocks resume.
Each feature owns its phases and backfill; AR-005-B provides metadata only.
